python3 - <<'PY'
import glob, os, subprocess, time
patterns=['/dev/cu.usbserial-*','/dev/cu.wchusbserial*','/dev/cu.SLAB_USBtoUART*','/dev/cu.usbmodem*']
def ports():
    return sorted(set(p for pat in patterns for p in glob.glob(pat)))
def protected(p):
    return os.path.basename(p).endswith('10')
candidates=[p for p in ports() if not protected(p)]
print('DIAG_CANDIDATES', candidates)
if len(candidates) != 1:
    print('PASSIVE_CAPTURE_SKIPPED expected_exactly_one_unprotected_candidate')
    raise SystemExit(0)
p=candidates[0]
try:
    busy=subprocess.run(['lsof',p],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
except Exception as e:
    busy=f'LSOF_ERROR {e}'
print('TARGET',p)
print('LSOF_TARGET_BEGIN')
print(busy)
print('LSOF_TARGET_END')
if busy and not busy.startswith('LSOF_ERROR'):
    print('PASSIVE_CAPTURE_SKIPPED target_busy')
    raise SystemExit(0)
import serial
s=serial.Serial()
s.port=p; s.baudrate=115200; s.timeout=0.25; s.dtr=False; s.rts=False
try:
    s.open()
except Exception as e:
    print('SERIAL_OPEN_FAILED',repr(e)); raise SystemExit(0)
print('SERIAL_OPEN_OK',p)
start=time.monotonic(); lines=[]; read_errors=[]
while time.monotonic()-start < 60.0:
    try:
        raw=s.readline()
    except Exception as e:
        read_errors.append((time.monotonic()-start,repr(e)))
        break
    if raw:
        lines.append((time.monotonic()-start,raw.decode('utf-8',errors='replace').rstrip()))
try: s.close()
except Exception: pass
keys=('ESP-ROM:esp32s3','rst:0x','Guru Meditation','panic','abort','watchdog','wdt','brownout','rebooting','Backtrace','ELF file SHA256','firmware_sha','i2c probe','scd_','scd41','eink_display','assert')
print('CAPTURE_SECONDS',round(time.monotonic()-start,2))
print('TOTAL_LINES',len(lines))
print('ROM_BOOT_COUNT',sum('ESP-ROM:esp32s3' in t for _,t in lines))
print('RST_COUNT',sum('rst:0x' in t for _,t in lines))
print('PANIC_COUNT',sum(('Guru Meditation' in t or 'panic' in t.lower() or 'abort' in t.lower()) for _,t in lines))
print('BROWNOUT_COUNT',sum('brownout' in t.lower() for _,t in lines))
print('REBOOTING_COUNT',sum('rebooting' in t.lower() for _,t in lines))
print('READ_ERRORS',read_errors)
print('PORTS_AFTER',ports())
print('DIAG_TIMELINE_BEGIN')
for dt,t in lines:
    if any(k.lower() in t.lower() for k in keys): print(f'{dt:07.2f}s | {t}')
print('DIAG_TIMELINE_END')
